written_branch.note: See our template for the information letter to ensure that data subjects receive all necessary information about the processing.

oral_branch.note: Information should be given in writing or electronically. Only in special circumstances is oral information appropriate, for example if a participant requests it. See what information you must provide.

how_will_sample_receive_information.question: How will the sample receive information about the processing?
how_will_sample_receive_information.description: As a general rule, there is an obligation to inform the data subjects about the processing of their personal data. Exceptions can apply if it will be impossible to provide the information or it will involve a disproportionate amount of effort to provide the information, seen in relation to the benefit of being informed, providing information is likely to make it impossible or extremely difficult to achieve the purpose of the processing, the individual already has the information or obtaining or disclosure of personal data is expressly laid down by law.
